title: Talu VM API
description: The typed contract for one Talu tenant VM. Ownership is marked with x-talu-owner exactly as in talu-tenant: 'consumer' = the integrator writes it per VM; 'operator' = the site supplies it once from environments/<site>/tenant-defaults.yaml. See docs/architecture/adr-api-layer.md §4 and §10.1.

projectUuid.description: talu.io/project-uuid stamped on every object; the manager join key.

allowedUsers.description: The tenant's members, stamped on the ssh Service for the Pomerium route renderer. Comes from the Tenant, not chosen per VM.

name.description: VM name, unique within the tenant.

principal.description: Guest OS user / SSH cert principal.

size.description: Named size -> VirtualMachineClusterInstancetype talu-<size> (components/tenancy/sizes/). Preferred over memory: it is the only way this API expresses vCPU, and KubeVirt enforces it. Mutually exclusive with memory.

memory.description: DEPRECATED legacy sizing, e.g. 1536Mi. Cannot express vCPU — KubeVirt defaults the guest to 1. Kept so pre-split tenants render unchanged; use size instead. Mutually exclusive with size.

securityGroups.description: Names of the tenant's security groups this VM joins. Rendered as talu.io/sg.<name> labels that the tenant's CiliumNetworkPolicies select on.

source.description: OPERATOR — which image mechanism the site's catalog uses. 'import' populates the root disk from restore.root.url instead of the catalog (the DR restore path, docs/architecture/drim-target.md §4.1).

rootDiskSize.description: Persistent root PVC size (source=dataSource or source=import).

restore.description: OPERATOR — populate the root disk from a DR package instead of the golden-image catalog (source=import). Which image a VM may boot is site plumbing, not a per-VM consumer choice; TenantVM deliberately cannot express it. See docs/architecture/drim-target.md §4.1.

root.description: OPERATOR — the root disk's import source.

url.description: OPERATOR — https:// (presigned, preferred: it leaves no credential in the tenant namespace) or s3://bucket/key.

secretRef.description: OPERATOR — Secret{accessKeyId,secretKey} in the tenant namespace; only for s3:// or authenticated https.

certConfigMap.description: OPERATOR — ConfigMap holding a CA bundle for a private HTTPS endpoint.

acknowledgeGuestTrust.description: OPERATOR — required for source=import. An imported guest does not trust this site's SSH User CA and cloud-init does not re-run on a provisioned disk, so the VM boots healthy and rejects every human login. Setting this states that guest trust is handled out of band (drim-target.md §4.3).

retrust.description: OPERATOR — write this site's SSH User CA into the imported disk offline (virt-customize) before first boot. While enabled the VM is held Halted; set false once the Job completes to boot it. UNVALIDATED — see the chart README.

image.description: OPERATOR — libguestfs image; track the cluster's KubeVirt version.

kubectlImage.description: OPERATOR — image for the init container that waits on the DataVolume.

forceTcg.description: OPERATOR — libguestfs boots an appliance VM; without /dev/kvm it must use TCG.

resetCloudInit.description: OPERATOR — clear the guest's cached cloud-init state so NoCloud re-runs. Off by default: on a restored guest this can undo in-guest configuration.

dataDisks.description: Extra non-root disks. Sizes are the consumer's; import URLs are the operator's, as for the root disk. A disk with no url is provisioned blank. The guest finds each at /dev/disk/by-id/virtio-<name>.

name.description: Disk name, unique within the VM; becomes the DataVolume suffix and the guest-visible serial.

url.description: OPERATOR — import source; empty means a blank disk.

secretRef.description: OPERATOR — Secret{accessKeyId,secretKey} for this disk's source.

certConfigMap.description: OPERATOR — ConfigMap holding a CA bundle for this disk's source.

sshUserCaPubKey.description: OPERATOR. Pomerium SSH User CA public key. Injected at reconcile time from ConfigMap pomerium-user-ca — never written by a consumer.

caTrust.description: OPERATOR. How SSH User CA trust reaches the guest — a site-wide choice tied to the golden-image build.

logging.description: Guest-side logging. Tier 1 (serial console) is always on; Tier 2 (agent) needs the tenant's logs-gateway, rendered by talu-tenant.

ingress.description: OPERATOR. Render the VM's Pomerium route as an Ingress (adr-pomerium-ingress.md) instead of relying on the route-sync CronJob. Off until the Ingress Controller is serving.
